headline: Computational frameworks link spatial transcriptomics to tissue geometry and histology
label: Spatial Transcriptomics Computational Methods
summary: Spatial transcriptomics increasingly pairs gene expression with histology and tissue geometry, requiring models that encode these coordinates directly.
synthesis: The dominant thread across these preprints is the incorporation of tissue structure into computational models of transcriptomic data. Spaceland reconstructs continuous high-resolution 3D gene-expression fields from sparse spatial transcriptomics and serial H&E histology using an optical-flow-based framework. CurvSeq and CurvSee integrate gland curvature with spatial transcriptomic and protein imaging data in prostate cancer. Loom is a visual computing system combining pseudo-temporal trajectory, cross-sample, and local microenvironment analysis for spatial transcriptomics. What is new is that spatial coordinates, histological images, and geometric descriptors enter the statistical model as direct inputs. Tangerine and IntraTalker address temporal regulation and intracellular signalling in non-spatial transcriptomic and single-cell data, while the tensor decomposition and network-diffusion items fall outside the spatial core.
